summary: Tested the feed fix and the new home page, both backend and frontend. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (paged response {posts, has_more, next_skip}, no overlap between pages, limit capped at 50, type/category/user_id filters, no images/_id in the feed JSON, image_urls, comment_count, user{name,role}, image endpoint returns binary PNG and 404s, create→feed top, comments→count). Frontend (desktop 1920 and mobile 390): login with maria@teste.com → /home shows 10 post cards; 'Carregar mais' → 12 cards and the button disappears; all 11 category chips and 4 type filters refetch correctly with empty state where expected; reload shows the feed right away; create post with image via the dialog → appears at top with the image loaded; comment add → counter shows '1 comentário'; /volunteers, /jobs and /direct-chat/:id render with the new response shape. No horizontal overflow on mobile. The original bug (published posts not appearing) is fixed.

minor.issue: Returns 500 'API key não configurada' because RAPIDAPI_KEY is not set in backend/.env. This existed before and is unrelated to the feed, but /jobs logs two 500 console errors. Should return 503 or an empty list, and the key needs to be set on Render.
Does not check that the post exists, and accepts an empty comment string (no min_length on the Pydantic model).
The backend sends Cache-Control: public, max-age=604800 (checked on localhost), but the preview ingress replaces it with no-store. This is expected in preview; check the header on Render.

issues: The 'Login bem-sucedido' toast covers the 'Olá, Maria.' greeting at the top for a few seconds (cosmetic)
Seeded post images are plain tan placeholders that look like loading skeletons; use real images for a better first impression
These pages still use the old blue/emoji style, which does not match the new 'Sereno e acolhedor' home (inconsistent look)

action_items: Optional: make /api/jobs/search fail gracefully (503 or empty list) when RAPIDAPI_KEY is missing, and set the key in the Render env
Optional: validate that the comment is non-empty and that the post exists in add_comment
Optional: JobsPage filters p.category === 'work' only on the client, so posts where 'work' appears only in categories[] are dropped; use the server-filtered result directly
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2198 lines; it should be split into routers (posts, jobs, housing, admin)
get_comments runs N+1 user lookups; batch them with $in the same way get_posts does
The image endpoint is unauthenticated (needed for ). Acceptable, but post images are public to anyone who has the id
Stale files HomePage.backup.js, HomePage.old.js, HomePage.old2.js and Home.jsx remain in pages/ and should be removed
seed_data_creation: None kept. TEST_ posts and comments were deleted afterwards; 12 seeded posts remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_feed_posts.py. The feed uses data-testids post-card-{id}, load-more-posts-btn, category-chip-*, type-filter-*, feed-empty, i-need-help-cta, create-post-*, post-comments-toggle/input/submit-{id}.
